effects.name: Highlight-bar hook
effects.when: Every reel’s first frame. Highlight bars in my brand yellow and charcoal, on screen from frame one.

effects.name: Compact yellow hook
effects.when: A quieter opener when the shot itself is the hook.

effects.name: Hook behind your head
effects.when: Short, punchy titles (2 lines max) tucked behind my head.
effects.onWindows: The hook sits on top of the shot instead of behind your head.

effects.name: Stacked captions
effects.when: Default. Your display font for the loud words, your caption font for the small ones between.

effects.name: Lead-in + punch word
effects.when: A small serif lead-in above one huge yellow word.

effects.name: One word at a time
effects.when: Calmer, premium, story-led reels.

effects.name: Glow captions
effects.when: Teaching and list reels: the whole line sits up, and each word lights up as you say it, so people read along.

effects.name: Boxed captions
effects.when: Busy or bright backgrounds where floating captions get lost.

effects.name: Blur-in captions
effects.when: A softer caption entrance for slower, reflective reels.

effects.name: Checklist that fills in
effects.when: "Ask yourself these 3 questions" reels. One line fills in per point, as it’s said.

effects.name: End card
effects.when: Last 2 to 3 seconds: the keyword or "part 2".

effects.name: Giant word behind your head
effects.when: The one word the reel hangs on, behind my head (ICON, LABEL).
effects.onWindows: The giant word is drawn in front of you.

effects.name: Serif numbers
effects.when: Numbered steps and big moments ("1 2 3", "BETTER RESULT").
effects.onWindows: The numbers are drawn in front of you.

effects.name: Word struck through
effects.when: Killing an old idea ("PROMPTS", "COURSES").

effects.name: Name label
effects.when: Introducing a person, step or section ("Step 1 · Photos").

effects.name: Accent label bar
effects.when: Brand moments: your show or business name on an accent-colour bar.

effects.name: Counter
effects.when: Any number that changed: 300 to 3,000 plays.

effects.name: Slot-machine number
effects.when: A big reveal number (26 effects, $85K).

effects.name: Burning word
effects.when: A dramatic one-liner ("COOKED."). Rarely.

effects.name: Glass type
effects.when: A premium title behind me (brand or platform names).
effects.onWindows: The glass word is drawn over the shot.

effects.name: Headline wrap
effects.when: A big statement in three or four short lines: the top lines tuck behind your head and the rest land in front of you, one by one.
effects.onWindows: All the lines are drawn in front of you, none tuck behind your head.

effects.name: Magazine cover
effects.when: Story reels and "the story of…" openers.
effects.onWindows: The masthead and cover lines are drawn over the shot.

effects.name: Paper cut
effects.when: A playful chapter break, with a white sticker outline around me.
effects.onWindows: Shown as a full-screen paper title card, without the white outline around you.

effects.name: Arrow note
effects.when: Pointing at me or something in frame ("can’t edit").

effects.name: Pinned question
effects.when: Framing the whole reel as a question.

effects.name: Colour title
effects.when: Opening line or chapter break: the background turns brand blue, I stay in front.
effects.onWindows: Shown as a full-screen colour title card for the same seconds; your voice carries on underneath.

effects.name: Screen behind you
effects.when: Real screenshots or b-roll of exactly what’s being said, fading into the shot.
effects.onWindows: Becomes a stacked shot: the screenshot or b-roll on the top half, you moved down underneath it.

effects.name: Stacked shot, blur seam
effects.when: A guest or second angle on top, me below. Never a hard split.

effects.name: Photo fan
effects.when: Showing a set of things (clothes, episodes, guests).
effects.onWindows: The photos are drawn in front of you.

effects.name: Camera snaps
effects.when: "Take photos of…" moments, one flash per photo.
effects.onWindows: The photos are drawn in front of you.

effects.name: Photo wall
effects.when: Volume and proof (every reel, every client).
effects.onWindows: The photos are drawn in front of you.

effects.name: Headline scatter
effects.when: Press, DMs or reviews landing around me.
effects.onWindows: The headlines are drawn in front of you.

effects.name: Orbit
effects.when: Cards circling me: tools, guests, platforms.
effects.onWindows: The cards circle over the shot rather than passing behind you.

effects.name: Sticker
effects.when: A logo or cut-out object popping in beside me.

effects.name: Icon strike
effects.when: "You don’t need CapCut" moments.

effects.name: Folder drop
effects.when: "Put them all in one folder" moments.

effects.name: Phone with views
effects.when: Showing a real post, with its view count ticking up.

effects.name: Envelope reveal
effects.when: The free guide or lead magnet in the call to action.

effects.name: Brand swatches
effects.when: Branding talk: brand colours and fonts fanning out.

effects.name: Receipts
effects.when: What something costs, then striking it out.

effects.name: Prompt bar
effects.when: The exact prompt, typing out.

effects.name: Prompt with files
effects.when: "I dropped my raw clips in…" moments.

effects.name: Chat
effects.when: A real back-and-forth with AI or a client.

effects.name: Approval pile-up
effects.when: Showing a pain multiplying (approvals, notifications).

effects.name: Task list
effects.when: A process ticking itself off.

effects.name: Calendar
effects.when: A content plan or posting week.

effects.name: Dropdown pick
effects.when: Choosing a model, setting or option.

effects.name: Effort dial
effects.when: “Turn it up to max” moments.

effects.name: Struck-out note
effects.when: "You don’t need X" lists.

effects.name: Tool spotlight
effects.when: "The one that matters is…": a grid, then one steps forward.

effects.name: Stat bars
effects.when: Show stats, before and after.

effects.name: Flow arrows
effects.when: Any process, step by step, on the explainer board.

effects.name: Glowing chart
effects.when: Growth over time (downloads, followers, revenue).

effects.name: Edit timeline
effects.when: Talking about editing or production.

effects.name: App background
effects.when: The whole background becomes the app I’m using.
effects.onWindows: Becomes the prompt bar over your shot, with the same typing.

effects.name: DM card
effects.when: The comment-keyword CTA, with the reply landing.

effects.name: Comment box
effects.when: CTA: the keyword typing into a comment, then Follow.

effects.name: Frame break
effects.when: A big moment: I pop out of the frame.
effects.onWindows: The frame shrinks with you inside it; you do not step out of the frame.

effects.name: Pull-back reveal
effects.when: Revealing the process behind the video.
effects.onWindows: The whole shot pulls back, you included.

effects.name: Doodle outline
effects.when: Light, funny moments.
effects.onWindows: The doodles wobble around you, without the white outline.

effects.name: Vertigo
effects.when: A realisation or an "it hit me" moment: the room stretches behind me while I stay still.
effects.onWindows: The whole shot zooms; you do not hold still while the room moves.

effects.name: Snap zoom
effects.when: Landing a punch line: the shot snaps in tight on the word, then holds.

effects.name: Zoom-through cut
effects.when: Diving into the next point or a new location: the shot rushes forward into the next one.

effects.name: Zoom-blur cut
effects.when: Jumping to the next point.

effects.name: Paper rip
effects.when: Hard change of topic or location.

effects.name: Glitch cut
effects.when: Tech moments, quick switches.

effects.name: Light flash
effects.when: Time jumps. Once a reel, max.

effects.name: Badges fly in
effects.when: Two or three short reactions or labels stacking beside me ("same feeling?", "new audience").

effects.name: Polaroids scatter
effects.when: Photos of real things I mention: products, people, moments. Taped polaroids drop in around me.

effects.name: Hand-drawn circle
effects.when: Pointing at one thing on screen: a number, a word, a detail in a screenshot.

effects.name: Stamped calendar
effects.when: Dates, launches, a posting schedule: stamps slam onto the days I name.

effects.name: Collage title
effects.when: Introducing who I am or what this is about: a huge word up the edge with paper tags.

effects.name: Photo-booth strip
effects.when: A run of moments or outfits; a 3D paper strip floats beside me.

effects.name: Paper curtain
effects.when: A clean chapter change: paper closes over the frame and opens on the next part.

effects.name: Paper slides in
effects.when: Into a new section or a list: a sheet slides up over the shot.

effects.name: Page turn
effects.when: Moving the story on ("next...", "then..."): a page sweeps across.

effects.name: Paper flip
effects.when: A reveal or a reset: the frame flips over to a paper card and back.

effects.name: Drop-in captions
effects.when: Punchy reels: each phrase drops in from above.

effects.name: Rise-from-blur captions
effects.when: Softer, story reels: phrases rise up out of a blur.

effects.name: Rubber stamp
effects.when: A verdict: SOLD, BOOKED, APPROVED, DONE. One slam, on the word.

effects.name: Screen shake
effects.when: A jolt on a punch line or a shock number. Pair it with a stamp or a big word.

effects.name: Phone notifications
effects.when: Results arriving: sales, bookings, new followers, DMs. Banners slide down and stack.

effects.name: Social post card
effects.when: Proof someone said it: a client win, a review, a quote. Real words only.

effects.name: Confetti burst
effects.when: A genuine win: a launch, a milestone, a sale. Use rarely, it loses its pop.

effects.name: Split-flap board
effects.when: A reveal of a place, a destination or a big word: the letters flip until they land.

effects.name: Scratch-off reveal
effects.when: Holding back the answer for a beat: the foil scratches away on the word.

effects.name: VHS rewind
effects.when: "Let me go back", "rewind to 2019": a flashback or a correction.

effects.name: Poll results
effects.when: When I quote a split ("most people say..."): the poll fills to the real numbers.

effects.name: Price tag
effects.when: A price or a cost: a paper tag drops in and swings.

effects.name: News ticker
effects.when: Breaking news, a launch or an announcement: a lower-third ticker scrolls.

effects.name: Before and after wipe
effects.when: Showing the raw take turning into the edit (or any before and after).

effects.name: Doc page
effects.when: Scripts, plans, briefs, SOPs: a doc page types out and the key line gets highlighted.
